verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents a dedicated MCP Server for agentic AI that supports virtual card issuance, spend controls, transaction intelligence, and dispute resolution, layered on a Core API that already supports card creation/update, transaction retrieval, and velocity/authorization spend controls. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scoped/limited credential issuance for the MCP surface and independent/hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in production use.
